name: BIST 5625
title: Introduction to Biostatistics
description: Rates and proportions, sensitivity, specificity, two-way tables, odds ratios, relative risk, ordered and non-ordered classifications, rends, case-control studies, elements of regression including logistic and Poisson, additivity and interaction, combination of studies and meta-analysis.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Biostatistics, others with permission.
